## Line Chart

The layer-matrix **Line Chart** element (the charts detour, revived with a real consumer: the Revenue Dashboard's MRR trend). Self-contained SVG — no chart library: `@points` ({label, value}[]), optional `@formatValue` for axis/endpoint labels. Renders an area fill, faint dashed grid at min/mid/max, the line, and an emphasized endpoint with its value — the endpoint IS the headline number.

```gts
import { LineChart } from '../line-chart';
<LineChart @points={{this.mrrByMonth}} @formatValue={{this.money}} />
```

Colors route through theme tokens (--primary/--border/--muted-foreground) so themes restyle it.

**Non-goals:** multiple series, tooltips/hover, time-axis math (points arrive ordered; bucketing is the consumer's job), donut/bar variants (deferred — v1 dashboard is line + CSS bars).
